secrets.name: AWS Access Key
secrets.remediation: Rotate this AWS key immediately and store it in Zo Secrets (Settings > Advanced).

secrets.name: AWS Secret Key
secrets.remediation: Rotate this AWS secret key and move it to Zo Secrets.

secrets.name: Private Key File
secrets.remediation: Remove this private key from the workspace. Store it in Zo Secrets or a proper key vault.

secrets.name: Stripe Secret Key
secrets.remediation: Move this Stripe key to Zo Secrets and reference it as process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.

secrets.name: Stripe Webhook Secret
secrets.remediation: Move this webhook secret to Zo Secrets.

secrets.name: GitHub Personal Access Token
secrets.remediation: Revoke this GitHub token at github.com/settings/tokens and store the new one in Zo Secrets.

secrets.name: Slack Token
secrets.remediation: Revoke this Slack token and regenerate via Slack API settings. Store in Zo Secrets.

secrets.name: Generic API Key Assignment
secrets.remediation: Move this API key to Zo Secrets (Settings > Advanced) and reference via environment variable.

secrets.name: Generic Secret/Password Assignment
secrets.remediation: Never hardcode secrets. Move to Zo Secrets and reference as an environment variable.

secrets.name: Password in URL
secrets.remediation: Remove credentials from URLs. Use environment variables for connection strings.

secrets.name: Google OAuth Client Secret
secrets.remediation: Move OAuth secrets to Zo Secrets. Do not commit credentials.json to version control.

secrets.name: SendGrid API Key
secrets.remediation: Revoke and regenerate this SendGrid key. Store in Zo Secrets.

secrets.name: Twilio Auth Token
secrets.remediation: Rotate this Twilio token and store in Zo Secrets.
